card.name: Subject position before past-tense had
card.fires_on: The subject noun or pronoun, or the word had itself, in narrative past-tense prose where a past-perfect or past verb is expected next. It appears in general web text, not drug labels.

modes.label: Subject before had
modes.description: A noun or pronoun subject right where a past-perfect had or was would come next.

modes.label: Inverted or cued subject
modes.description: A subject after an auxiliary or in an inverted clause, awaiting a past verb.
modes.example: as many times did<< he>> discard his choice for another.

card.writes: It pushes the model away from predicting had and was, and toward present-tense verbs like has, are and contains.
card.plain: It marks a spot in a story about the past where the next word is likely a past-tense helper like had or was.
